purpose: Slide-local numerical check for cyclic monotonicity, using original synthetic point samples.
sign_convention: cyclic_residual = sum_i dot(x_i - x_{i+1}, p_i), with x_{m+1}=x_0; a subgradient cycle has residual >= 0.

rotation_counterexample.interpretation: The rotation has zero pairwise monotone residuals because its symmetric part is zero, but it cannot be a gradient subdifferential map.
